summary_1line: Encouraged by the monkeys, Hanuman expands his form, proclaims his immense powers, climbs Mount Mahendra, and prepares to leap across the sea to Lanka.

image_candidates.scene_text: Hanuman grows to a विशाल form among cheering monkeys, tail raised high as he prepares to leap toward the distant sea.
Standing atop Mount Mahendra, Hanuman's immense body shakes the mountain as trees shudder, animals flee, and rocks split under his strength.
From the flowering summit of Mahendra, Hanuman gathers power to leap, the ocean stretching far below and the sky opening before him.
